title: Crypto Foundations: Different Rules
author: StockIQ

cover.alt: A crowd of cut-paper figures holds up an open ledger bearing a single coin, an empty pedestal beside them — a currency kept by a network of people, not a company.

blurb: Digital assets don't play by stock-market rules. Learn what a token really is, who holds the keys, why the business-analysis math doesn't apply, and how not to get burned.
